summary: A local official Sumedang geospatial portal is evidenced, but it was unavailable as a Cloudflare error page. ATR/BPN's public catalog was reachable and exposed no Sumedang parcel layer; the advertised GeoServer host failed DNS resolution. No geometry sample was retained and no adapter was qualified.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: English and Indonesian discovery queries were executed with actual URLs recorded in the city record. Local SIGEOL GET returned a Cloudflare 5xx page. Anonymous ATLAS resource listing returned seven datasets without a Sumedang parcel layer. Advertised WFS metadata requests failed DNS before any response.
scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [-6.82984799316414, 107.937736915745] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
No exact-point or bbox parcel hit was obtained; timeout, login/UI unavailability, DNS failure, or absent catalog entry is not evidence of citywide absence.
The local portal's indexed 'Persil yang sudah dipetakan' table is evidence of a relevant local mapping program, not evidence of a usable open parcel API or citywide geometry coverage.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, account, NIB, rights-status, or other unsafe attributes were requested or retained.
safeFieldAllowlist: native parcel ID if publicly exposed
uncertainty: SIGEOL's current JavaScript/configuration, service endpoint, CRS, and parcel schema could not be inspected from this environment.
ATLAS's anonymous catalog did not expose a Sumedang parcel dataset, but catalog absence is not proof that the national service has no such data.
The remote GeoServer hostname published in ATLAS metadata may be transiently unresolvable.
